record.NAME: k_scw_min_host_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum ego speed at which SCW feature is enabled.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_host_speed_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Value subtracted from the k_scw_min_host_speed to apply hysteresis for the activation of SCW function.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_guardrail_age
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum age of the guardrail to be considered as valid for SCW.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_lat_pos_ratio
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum ratio between current and previous values of guardrail lateral distance. Lateral distance is frozen for k_scw_guardrail_freeze_period consecutive cycles above this threshold.

record.NAME: k_scw_guardrail_freeze_period
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral distance is frozen for k_scw_guardrail_freeze_period consecutive cycles if the guardrail is unplausible.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_heading
record.DESCRIPTION: Only objects with heading in the specified value range are considered SCW candidates.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_heading_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Value subtracted from minimum heading or added to maximum heading, to apply hysteresis for the SCW candidate.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_yawrate
record.DESCRIPTION: Only objects with yawrate in the specified value range are considered SCW candidates.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_yawrate_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Value added to maximum yawrate, to apply hysteresis for the SCW candidate.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_velocity
record.DESCRIPTION: Only objects with an absolute velocity in the specified value range are considered SCW candidates.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_velocity_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Value subtracted from minimum relative velocity or added to maximum relative velocity, to apply hysteresis for the SCW candidate.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_relative_velocity
record.DESCRIPTION: Only objects with relative longitudinal velocity in the specified value range are considered SCW candidates.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_relative_vel_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: Value subtracted from min relative longitudinal velocity threshold or added to the max threshold, to apply hysteresis for the SCW candidate.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_candidate_age
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum age of the object to be considered as a valid candidate for SCW.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_candidate_existence_probability
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum existence probability of the object to be considered as a valid candidate for SCW.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_exist_prob_radar_guardrail
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum existence probability of a radar guardrail to determine, if an SCW candidate is in conflict with its environment.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_dynamic_lat_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum critical lateral TTC of the dynamic object to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_dynamic_lat_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum critical lateral TTC of the dynamic object to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_guardrail_lat_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum critical lateral TTC of the guardrail to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_guardrail_lat_ttc
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum critical lateral TTC of the guardrail to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_trailer_lat_ttc_extension
record.DESCRIPTION: The extension of the min lateral TTC when the trailer is attached.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_dynamic_lat_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum critical lateral distance to the dynamic object to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_dynamic_lat_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum critical lateral distance to the dynamic object to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_min_guardrail_lat_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: The minimum critical lateral distance to the guardrail to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_guardrail_lat_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum critical lateral distance to the guardrail to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_guardrail_lat_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: The maximum critical lateral distance to the guardrail to trigger an alert.

record.NAME: k_scw_critical_lat_ttc_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: The critical lateral ttc hysteresis.

record.NAME: k_scw_critical_lat_distance_hys
record.DESCRIPTION: The critical lateral distance hysteresis.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_adjust_zones_to_ego_size
record.DESCRIPTION: If enabled the SCW zones defined by k_scw_initial_zone_x and k_scw_initial_zone_y will be relative to the host vehicle side and will be extended by the host vehicle length.

record.NAME: k_scw_initial_zone_x
record.DESCRIPTION: X-coordinate of corners of polygon defining SCW zone of the right side. First coordinate should be right front corner of zone, subsequent coordinates should be clockwise.

record.NAME: k_scw_initial_zone_y
record.DESCRIPTION: Y-coordinate of corners of polygon defining SCW zone of the right side. First coordinate should be right front corner of zone, subsequent coordinates should be clockwise.

record.NAME: k_scw_hys_zone_x_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: Offsets to be added to the x-coordinate of the initial zone to get the hysteresis zone.

record.NAME: k_scw_hys_zone_y_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: Offsets to be added to the y-coordinate of the initial zone to get the hysteresis zone.

record.NAME: k_scw_candidate_mature_cycles_in_zone_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: An object is required to be in the SCW zone with mature object status for at least this many cycles before it qualifies as critical object.

record.NAME: k_scw_guardrail_cycles_in_zone_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: A guardrail is required to be in the SCW zone for at least this many consecutive cycles before it qualifies as critical object.

record.NAME: k_scw_lateral_distance_default
record.DESCRIPTION: Max value of lateral distance, usually equal to the max value.

record.NAME: k_scw_lateral_ttc_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Max value of lateral TTC.

record.NAME: k_scw_lateral_ttc_default
record.DESCRIPTION: Default value of lateral TTC, usually equal to the max value.

record.NAME: k_scw_ttle_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Max value of TTLE.

record.NAME: k_scw_ttle_default
record.DESCRIPTION: Default value of TTLE, usually equal to the max value.

record.NAME: k_scw_ttp_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Max value of TTP.

record.NAME: k_scw_ttp_default
record.DESCRIPTION: Default value of TTP, usually equal to the max value.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether vehicle input or cal shall be used to enable/disable SCW.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_dynamic_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether vehicle input or cal shall be used to enable/disable subfunction SCW dynamic objects.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_guardrail_enable_via_cal
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether vehicle input or cal shall be used to enable/disable subfunction SCW guardrail.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether SCW shall be enabled or disabled if CAF input is not used.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_enable_dynamic
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether subfunction SCW dynamic objects shall be enabled or disabled if CAF input is not used.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_enable_guardrail
record.DESCRIPTION: Decides whether subfunction SCW guardrail shall be enabled or disabled if CAF input is not used.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_enable_trailer_zone_extension
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables an additional adjustment of the SCW zone based on trailer information in core input.

record.NAME: k_scw_f_enable_trailer_ttc_extension
record.DESCRIPTION: Allows to increase of lateral ttc of a dynamic object or guardrail if a trailer is attached.

record.NAME: k_scw_trailer_zone_ext_safety_margin
record.DESCRIPTION: Longitudinal extension of the rear edge of the SCW zone behind the trailer edge.

record.NAME: k_scw_trailer_zone_ext_safety_margin_lat
record.DESCRIPTION: Lateral extension of the SCW zone.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_zone_length
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum length of the SCW zone.

record.NAME: k_scw_max_zone_width
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum width of the SCW zone.
